biggest_catch: The 90-day pending period plus once-a-month payment batches mean your first payout can take four-plus months to arrive — and paying with a gift card generally voids the rebate entirely.
catches: Cashback rates vary by store and can be corrected at Mr. Rebates' discretion; rebates are not guaranteed income.
Pending rebates stay pending for 90 days from the posting date to cover returns, cancellations, and commission collection.
Paying for an order with a gift card generally voids the cash back (official FAQ).
Each order needs a separate click-through in the same session — orders placed outside Mr. Rebates do not qualify and cannot be credited retroactively.
$10 in 'Available Rebates' required to request a payment via check or PayPal.
Mr. Rebates tracks your purchases through affiliate links to attribute rebates — a real privacy trade-off.

steps: Install the Mr. Rebates browser extension (or use the Mr. Rebates site) and create a free account.
Click through Mr. Rebates to the store and complete your purchase in that same session (one click-through per order).
Do not pay with a gift card — it generally voids the rebate.
Track the rebate in your account; it posts as 'Pending' first.
Wait out the 90-day pending period for the rebate to become 'Available'.
Once you have $10+ in 'Available Rebates', request payment via the site's payment form (check mailed monthly, or PayPal).
timing: Pending rebates wait 90 days; all payments are sent at the beginning of each month for the previous month's requests.
